name: Plaitsy - main board (starter)
description: Seed breakout + sockets locked; place the CV input stages with Auto-layout.
notes:
Plaitsy main board starter, seen from the component side (the side the breakout plugs into).
Locked: the breakout (columns 1 and 7, USB/audio end at row 0) and the board-to-board sockets,
which must stay where they are: each meets a faceplate pin at faceplate hole (row, 22 - col).
LED resistors are placed under the breakout. Run Auto-layout for the rest with the board size locked.
Leave out the socket contacts the breakout does not use (see docs/design.md), so strips can pass.
Build it from two pieces of 24-strip stripboard split between rows 23 and 24.

componentDefs.name: Daisy Seed on seed_power_opamps breakout (socket strips)
